note: Bottom lab. BOTH windows carry survivorship bias: the universe is today's >= Rs 1,000 Cr names, so stocks that bottomed and never recovered (or delisted) are absent, which flatters every bottom-buying result. See portfolio[*].survivorship and the baseline_mcap portfolios for the bound.

definitions.A: close <= 30% below 52w high; volume >= 3x 20d avg; close in top 30% of range; close > prev close
definitions.B: >= 5 consecutive lower closes ending yesterday; RSI(2) yesterday < 5; today close > prev close
definitions.C: RSI(14) < 30 on one of the last 5 sessions, < 30 yesterday, >= 30 today
definitions.D: close < lower Bollinger(20,2) yesterday (so within the last 3 sessions), first close back inside today
definitions.E: close < 200-DMA for >= 40 consecutive sessions ending yesterday; close > 200-DMA today
definitions.F: today's low < lowest low of prior 20 sessions (lo_20_prior); close > that low
definitions.G: swing low (11-bar centre) 15-60 sessions ago, >= 25% under its 52w high; min low of last 10 sessions within +/-3% of it and >= 25% under the 52w high; today's close > max high between the lows; no G signal in the prior 5 sessions
definitions.H: close >= 25% below the 200-DMA; RSI(14) > RSI(14) 3 sessions ago
definitions.I: last session of the week; close > 50-day SMA; the previous >= 8 week-end closes were all below it
definitions.J: yesterday's close within 5% of the 52w low; today close >= +4%; volume >= 2x 20d avg
definitions._wash: twist: min mkt_breadth_50 over the last 20 sessions < 30
definitions.struct_stop: reversal bar's low (G: min low of last 10 sessions), accepted only if 3-20% below entry

recent_rules_on_extended.note: The recent-window groomed rules applied verbatim to the extended window (2018-06..2026-09): the out-of-sample test of the recent TRADE flags.
